records.title: Large Language Models as In-context AI Generators for Quality-Diversity
records.evidence: Uniformly samples archive examples; queries feature centroids using uniform or empty-cell-first strategies; generates parameter vectors with a fitness/feature prompt. Reports batch 10, 1000 generations, Mistral-7B-v0.1.
records.overlap: Target-directed generation using a QD archive already exists.
records.difference: OPENEND primary contrast changes parent weights relative to fixed references; it excludes explicit feature queries.
records.role: Required comparison for any future target-generation claim
records.review_status: selected methods inspected; not complete full-paper audit

records.title: Generating a Diversity of Challenging Programming Puzzles with Autotelic Generative Models
records.evidence: Generates puzzles toward semantic skill targets using archived examples; solver attempts estimate difficulty and executable checks establish successful solutions. Uses 50 solver attempts; unsolved puzzles are discarded.
records.overlap: Goal-conditioned diversity plus executable evaluation is established.
records.difference: OPENEND searches packing policies on fixed tasks; ACES generates tasks.
unresolved: Detailed target sampler and appendices still need extraction
Solver-dependent difficulty is not packing utility
records.review_status: selected methods inspected; not complete full-paper audit

records.title: Rethinking Code Similarity for Automated Algorithm Design with LLMs
records.evidence: Uses execution-trajectory similarity in FunSearch island assignment and cross-island selection. EoH integration uses dominance-dissimilarity parent probabilities and survival. Specifies matched evaluation budgets.
records.overlap: Behavior-based selection and diversity in algorithm search are close prior art.
records.difference: OPENEND uses fixed reference-policy distances on finite decision probes, with archive machinery held fixed in its primary contrast.
unresolved: Exact distance and normalization audit remains
Evaluation budgets alone do not establish equal model-token cost
records.role: Priority close comparator; no broad behavioral-search novelty claim
records.review_status: selected methods inspected; not complete full-paper audit
